analytics.name: Analytic 1774
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect Calendar Entries by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate API Calls via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: ContentResolver.query(CalendarContract) with query_count > $CalendarQueryThreshold$ by app NOT IN $ApprovedCalendarApps$]; Network Traffic Flow via Android Enterprise Network Logging / Enterprise VPN [DevicePolicyManager.retrieveNetworkLogs(): DnsEvent / ConnectEvent; VPN flow metadata]; Permissions Request via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: Exchange, Google Calendar, enterprise calendar sync apps.
Default 30 queries/2min. Tune per calendar sync app baseline.

log_sources.name: mobile:DynamicAnalysis
log_sources.channel: Dynamic API/runtime trace: ContentResolver.query(CalendarContract) with query_count > $CalendarQueryThreshold$ by app NOT IN $ApprovedCalendarApps$
